evidence.reason: The test uses stale checksum "2"*64 while the refreshed checksum is "3"*64 and the downloaded bytes are b"unexpected". Both checksums mismatch b"unexpected", so even an implementation that incorrectly verifies against the stale manifest still raises ValueError. The test therefore cannot distinguish stale-manifest use from refreshed-manifest use. Writing vm.sha256_bytes(b"unexpected") as the stale checksum while keeping the refreshed checksum different would make the test fail under the stale-checksum bug.
